audit.whatIsWrong: Three places state that Pantheon's passive blocks Lillia's autos ('His passive blocks your Q autos', 'his passive blocking your Q autos', 'Pantheon's passive blocks your Q autos and last-hits'). Mortal Will does not block anything.
audit.why: Riot's text for Mortal Will is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' The auto-blocking passive was pre-rework Aegis Protection and no longer exists. A player told their autos are blocked will decline free last-hits and free Q-ring poke all through the early game, which is the opposite of correct.
audit.corrected: All three strings rewritten to Mortal Will's real effect — an empowered next spell — and the advice re-anchored on Comet Spear's 575 range instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows contradicted the content whys: Levels 1, 2 and 6 were credited to Lillia or Skill when the whys say Pantheon wins them, First item was Pantheon when the whys call it genuinely even, and 2+ items was Pantheon when the whys say Lillia out-scales.
audit.why: Pantheon front-loads everything: Comet Spear at 575, Shield Vault as a point-and-click stun on 13/12/11/10/9s, and Grand Starfall at 5500 range. He then falls off hard, while Liandry's/Riftmaker turn Lillia's W and Dream Dust into percent-HP damage.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Pantheon x5 / Skill / Lillia with ratings 3, 3, 4, 4, 3, 5, 7, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 is directionally right, though the packet's 20% win rate is over only 5 games. The level-chart whys already carry the honest read: concede levels 1-5, win the game after first item.

Aegis Assault (E) is a 22/21/20/19/18s front-facing invulnerability channel — the longest cooldown in his kit and interruptible. The mirror audit records that the Pantheon-side page was telling him to spend it blocking a Lillia disengage that does not exist; nothing on the Lillia side repeats that error.
audit.corrected: No change needed on this side.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Comet Spear pokes you for free at 575 while you have one ability and no kite chain to answer.

edits.before: W sweetspot threat starts — anyone chasing you eats the big hit while your Dream Dust burns their HP bar.
edits.after: Comet Spear out-ranges your 450 Q hop and chips you before Dream Dust ever stacks — you cannot trade.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-kite in circles, E from fog for the slow, and the passive speed makes every trade yours to end.
edits.after: Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun: it cancels your speed kite and chains an empowered Spear.

edits.before: The lane is a treadmill he can't get off — Q every step-up, kite the Shield Vault (Stun) window, and bank Dream Dust burn.
edits.after: Full Q rank means nothing when a 9s stun pins you the instant you enter Dream Dust range — the burn never compounds.

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby online — your jungler's ganks are now guaranteed, and any overstep becomes a sleep-execute.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby is too delayed to interrupt a point-and-click W, so he still wins the level 6 all-in.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Your Liandry's/Riftmaker W burn matches his flattening spear damage — the lane is genuinely even now.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: Pantheon hard-falls-off while your DoT deals percent-HP and your R sets up roams — you out-scale.

edits.before: His passive blocks your Q autos and he Spears you for free — you have one ability and no kite chain to answer.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts and he Spears you for free — you have no kite chain yet.

edits.before: Pantheon's Comet Spear poke plus his passive blocking your Q autos chunks you before you have a kite chain — his hardest early window.
edits.after: Pantheon's Comet Spear poke plus Mortal Will empowering his next spell chunks you before you have a kite chain — his hardest early window.

edits.after: Poke you down with Comet Spear while Mortal Will empowers his next spell

edits.before: Pantheon's passive blocks your Q autos and last-hits, so stepping up to sweetspot a Q just feeds him a free block and a Comet Spear in your face — you cannot win an auto-trade at level 1. His W is a point-click stun: the instant you commit a Q hop he stuns you out of your move-speed and your entire kite identity dies. Last-hit from max Q range, never walk into Spear range to start the Dream Dust burn, and accept you concede these levels.
edits.after: Pantheon's Comet Spear out-ranges everything you own at 575, so stepping up to sweetspot a Q just feeds him a free poke and an empowered spear in your face — you cannot win an auto-trade at level 1. His W is a point-click stun: the instant you commit a Q hop he stuns you out of your move-speed and your entire kite identity dies. Last-hit from max Q range, never walk into Spear range to start the Dream Dust burn, and accept you concede these levels.

notes: Real fabrication removed: the page said in three places that Pantheon's passive blocks Lillia's autos. Mortal Will empowers his next spell; nothing in his current kit blocks basic attacks. Win rate is 20% but over only 5 games — I did not move the 7/10 difficulty on that sample.
